decisions.reason: The maintenance oil line now looks like the firm's clear care-product winner after earlier portfolio pruning, supporting recurring after-sales business with strong fit to its wood-floor core.
The moisture-protection underlay remains a sensible installation accessory for trade customers and project work, especially after weaker underlay variants were already removed.
The oak parquet line is firmly anchored in the firm's main competence, brand, and growth strategy, so withdrawal within the next year is unlikely unless sales disappoint materially.
